√phal1 'burst'
present: [1.] phalati etc. E.+ 
perfect: paphāla phelus 
[aorist: apīphalat apālīt phaliṣyati phalitā ]
verbal: phalita E.+ 
secondary: intensive: pamphul- -- desiderative: piphaliṣa- -- causative: phālayati etc. 
derivatives: phálaka B.+ phalin C. phā́la V.+ phulla E.+ 
See √2phal. The pple phullant M1. is doubtless a denominative formation from phulla.

√phal2 'fruit'
present: [1.] phalati etc. E.+ phalate 
perfect: phelire 
future: phaliṣyati etc. E.+ 
verbal: phalita E.+ 
derivatives: phála V.+ phalitavya E. 
Doubtless in reality a denominative of phála, which from √1phal.
